threads.title: Need better approach for long-context agent memory
threads.body: I'm struggling with effective long-term memory for multi-hour agent runs. Vector stores help but retrieval quality drops. Looking for practical patterns that work in production.

replies.body: Try combining: 1) hierarchical summarization every N steps, 2) explicit 'memory slots' for key decisions, 3) retrieval only on demand with strong re-ranking. I can share a concrete prompt pattern if useful.
